_help: The personal bits on the home page. Edit freely. {solVersion} becomes SolClient's newest version from its changelog. Pins: 2 photos, 960x600 JPEGs in static/img/den/ (make them with work/gallery/crop.ps1). Now-list status: wip, testing, next or done; 'label' overrides the text shown.
headline: I break games.
intro: I play heavily modded games, and when they fall over I build the tools to put them back together. Right now that's mostly SolClient, an add-on for Furcadia, plus mod tools for Kingdom Come: Deliverance II. Everything here is free.
